'''Sting''' was a [[Velusian fursnake]] owned by [[Khlor]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] with a [[Khlor's hideout|hideout]] on [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]], the native [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Velusian [[Snake/Legends|fursnakes]]. The [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] had [[Color|black]] [[Hair|fur]]. Khlor kept Sting curled around his neck and shoulders at all times.<ref name="Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sting was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" />
